sap-s4-product-master.description: MCP server for the SAP S/4HANA Product Master Data OData API (API_PRODUCT_SRV). Provides read-only access to product master records, descriptions, and basic texts.

get_metadata_api_product_srv.description: Get metadata of the OData service with optional filtering to reduce token consumption. Returns the metadata in XML format, which can be used to discover available entities and their properties.

EntitySets.description: Comma-separated list of entity sets to filter metadata

get_metadata_api_product_srv.mock_response: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><edmx:Edmx Version="1.0" xmlns:edmx="http://schemas.microsoft.com/ado/2007/06/edmx"><edmx:DataServices><Schema Namespace="API_PRODUCT_SRV" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/ado/2008/09/edm"><EntityType Name="A_ProductType"><Key><PropertyRef Name="Product"/></Key><Property Name="Product" Type="Edm.String" Nullable="false" MaxLength="40"/><Property Name="ProductType" Type="Edm.String" MaxLength="4"/><Property Name="ProductGroup" Type="Edm.String" MaxLength="9"/><Property Name="BaseUnit" Type="Edm.String" MaxLength="3"/><Property Name="Division" Type="Edm.String" MaxLength="2"/><Property Name="GrossWeight" Type="Edm.Decimal" Precision="13" Scale="3"/><Property Name="NetWeight" Type="Edm.Decimal" Precision="13" Scale="3"/></EntityType></Schema></edmx:DataServices></edmx:Edmx>

batch_for_api_product_srv.description: Execute multiple OData operations in a single batch request using the $batch endpoint.

requests.description: Array of OData requests to batch

list_a_product_for_api_product_srv.description: Retrieve a list of entities from the A_Product collection in the api_product_srv service.

$top.description: Maximum number of records to return (max 100)

$filter.description: OData filter expression, e.g. ProductGroup eq 'ELECTR'

$select.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return

get_a_product_for_api_product_srv.description: Retrieve a single entity by its key from the A_Product collection in the api_product_srv service.

Product.description: Product number (material number) — the unique key for the product

$select.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return

count_a_product_for_api_product_srv.description: Get the total count of entities in the A_Product collection.

$filter.description: OData filter expression to count matching records
